Department of English
UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU
The eligible candidates are invited for walk-in-interview for the post of
Guest Lecturer in the Department of English, Bhaderwah Campus,
Universityof Jammu. The appointment on the post will be purely on
temporary basis till further orders.
Interested eligible candidates should report at Office of the I/C Head,
Department of English, Bhaderwah Campus for walk-in-interview on 11th
March 2024 at 03:00 PM with all relevant documents in original.
I/C Head
BHADARWAH CAMPUS
Office Address: Department of English, University of Jammu, village Sungli Bhaderwah. Pin 182222
Ph: 01997-44306 (Fax), Mob: +91-9697628969, e-mail: rakeshbcju@gmail.com
TERMS & CONDITIONS
1. The Guest Lecturer shall be eligible for remuneration as per the
University norms.
2. The candidate will not be entitled to any other benefits, which are
admissible to the regularemployees of University of Jammu.
3. This engagement will not vest any right to claim for regular
appointment in University of Jammu or for continued services in
the University.
4. The University reserves the right to terminate this engagement
any time in case of unsatisfactory performance, misconduct or any
otheradministrative reasons/ compulsions.
5. In case of any dispute/ ambiguity that may occur in the process
of selection, the decision ofthe University shall be final.
6.Candidates must report at Bhaderwah Campus for Walk-In-
Interview on prescribed date and timealongwith all supporting
documents in original.
I/C Head
